Аду готовят к работе в чужих домах: взят: Ada is being prepared to work in other people's homes, and her task is to pick up a cube from the table. The budget is 60 units for three sources: robot demonstrations with an operator, simulation episodes and human video. Put together a plan within the budget with which the model holds the cube in at least 70% of attempts in 48 homes where Ada has never been.
Демонстрации робота самые точные, но за: Robot demonstrations are the most accurate, but 60 units buy only 20 of them, all from four homes, and a model trained on them holds the cube in about half of the attempts in new homes. Simulation alone gives hundreds of different kitchens, but its image is cleaner than real life, and a generated grasp holds even where a real one would slip, so a model trained on it stays at about 60%. Human video adds almost nothing: its actions belong to a different body. A mix of a few robot demonstrations and hundreds of simulation episodes goes above 70%: the robot data ties the model to Ada's camera and to where the gripper actually holds, and the simulation provides the diversity. That's how the data pyramid works.
